user.title: Domyos Rower
user.description: Pull the handle to wake the rower and enable its Bluetooth, then pick it.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

strava_ask.title: Strava upload (optional)
strava_ask.description: TCX, GPX and FIT files are always created when you stop recording. Do you also want a button to send a session to Strava? (Nothing is ever uploaded automatically.)

strava_app.title: Strava application
strava_app.description:
1. Open https://www.strava.com/settings/api and create your API application (any name/site).
2. Set **localhost** as the "Authorization Callback Domain".
3. Paste the **Client ID** (a number) and the **Client Secret** here.

strava_code.title: Authorise access to Strava

abort.no_devices_found: No Domyos rower found. Wake it up (pull the handle) and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

error.invalid_client_id: The client ID must be a number.
error.strava_auth_failed: Strava refused this code. Authorise again (a code works once and expires quickly).

init.title: Session export
init.description: Folder where the TCX, GPX and FIT files are written. GPX is a GPS format: an indoor session has no position, so every point uses the coordinates below (your Home Assistant home by default).
